roadmaps.title: Observational Astronomy
roadmaps.tagline: Learn the night sky with your eyes, binoculars, and eventually a telescope.

roadmaps.title: Home Horticulture
roadmaps.tagline: Grow food and flowers that actually thrive, from soil test to seed saving

roadmaps.title: Kitchen Confidence

roadmaps.title: Functional Fitness

roadmaps.curricula: NASM & ACE training fundamentals, physical-literacy curricula

roadmaps.tagline: Evidence-based self-care skills — and knowing when to get real help
roadmaps.curricula: CBT protocols (Beck), Kabat-Zinn's MBSR, WHO mental-health guidance

roadmaps.title: Mindfulness & Meditation
roadmaps.tagline: Train attention and equanimity with a practice that actually survives contact with real life

roadmaps.curricula: Stanford CCT, Rosenberg's Nonviolent Communication, Neff's self-compassion research

roadmaps.title: Speaking & Communication
roadmaps.tagline: From listening well to holding a room: the speaking skills nobody formally teaches you

roadmaps.tagline: Learn how music actually works — rhythm, melody, harmony, and a trained ear.

roadmaps.title: Photography Essentials
roadmaps.tagline: See light, master exposure, and make deliberate photographs — phone camera included.
